# The beehave process dies while the run waits, and the deadline passes while no process runs (a window of 60 seconds). The next run finds
# the request expired and asks whether to extend. The process dies again while that question waits. The third run keeps the question,
# a person answers extend, and the roles sign inside the extension. The deadline is a ledger fact, so no process has to run at the time.
# No notice and no extension repeats across the three processes.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann sam pat
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=60
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec beehavereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitfile notices.log
kill -KILL
wait

# The deadline passes with no process.
exec sleep 65
! exec beehavereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'The deadline passed'
kill -KILL
wait

exec beehavereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'The deadline passed'
exec beehavereal answer req-1 --as rita extend
exec signoff sam security approve req-1 msa
exec signoff pat product approve req-1 msa
wait
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

grep -count=1 '^version-req-1-' notices.log
grep -count=1 '^escalate-req-1 rita' notices.log
# The first process died before any reminder was due. The next one woke past both levels and the deadline, so it owes both reminders
# before the escalation, in order, and the later processes repeat none.
grep -count=1 '^remind-req-1-1 ' notices.log
grep -count=1 '^remind-req-1-2 ' notices.log
exec sh -c 'grep -n -e "^remind-req-1-1 " -e "^remind-req-1-2 " -e "^escalate-req-1 " notices.log | cut -d: -f2 | cut -d" " -f1 | tr "\n" " "'
stdout '^remind-req-1-1 remind-req-1-2 escalate-req-1 $'
exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 - $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout -count=1 '\textended\t'
stdout -count=1 '\topened\t'
stdout '\tclosed\t.*\tapproved\t'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The release candidate.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
